about: Printed and online reference works that Civgraph's election results are taken from or checked against, listed as Sources so a reader following a citation can find them. Curated by hand; facts about each work only (title, author, publisher, year, what it covers and how Civgraph uses it). No text, tables or figures from any work are reproduced. Read by scripts/build-browse-indexes.mjs, which adds how many contests cite each work from data/database/election-provenance.json (matched by `citedAs`).

sources.title: Northern Ireland Parliamentary Election Results 1921-1972
sources.editorNote: compiled and edited by Sydney Elliott
sources.description: The results of every general election and by-election to the House of Commons of the Parliament of Northern Ireland from 1921 to 1969: the multi-member county and borough seats and Queen's University (1921-25), the single-member seats (1929-69), and statistical tables. The vote figures were compiled mainly from newspapers, as the volume's introductory notes say.
sources.uses: The source Civgraph cites for Stormont results 1921-69, and for the electorates of those contests, which the imported results did not record.
sources.copyright: Copyright 1973. Cited for facts only; no pages or figures from it are reproduced.

sources.title: Parliamentary Election Results in Ireland, 1801-1922
sources.series: A New History of Ireland, Ancillary Publications II
sources.description: The results of the general elections and by-elections in Irish constituencies to the House of Commons of the United Kingdom, from the Union in 1801 to 1922.
sources.uses: Cited for the results of Irish seats at Westminster from 1801 to 1922, and checked against Civgraph's figures contest by contest.
sources.copyright: Cited for facts only; no pages or figures from it are reproduced.

sources.title: Parliamentary Election Results in Ireland, 1918-92
sources.description: The results of parliamentary elections in Ireland from 1918 to 1992: Westminster seats, Dáil Éireann, the Parliament of Northern Ireland and the bodies that followed it, and the European Parliament.
sources.uses: Cited for Dáil, Westminster, Stormont, Assembly, Convention and European Parliament results it covers, and checked against Civgraph's figures where they have been read.
sources.copyright: Cited for facts only; no pages or figures from it are reproduced.

sources.title: Irish Elections 1922-44: Results and Analysis
sources.description: Constituency results and by-elections for the general elections to Dáil Éireann from 1922 to 1944, with analysis. No official record of a general election before 1948 exists; every result in the volume was rebuilt from the provincial press. Published free as a PDF, with minor amendments (2023), by the Department of Political Science, Trinity College Dublin.
sources.uses: Cited for Dáil results 1922-44; valid polls and electorates are checked against it, and supplied from it where Civgraph had none.
sources.copyright: Cited for facts only; no pages or figures from it are reproduced.

sources.title: Northern Ireland House of Commons Election Results
sources.copyright: Read for facts (figures) only; the site's tables are not reproduced.
sources.description: A website giving the results of elections to the House of Commons of Northern Ireland (Stormont), 1921-69, by county and borough, with the Queen's University seats and the boundaries. The full-results source that ARK Northern Ireland Elections links to. The site is no longer online; Civgraph reads the Internet Archive copies of January to August 2020.
sources.uses: Read alongside Elliott (1973) for Stormont results and electorates: the electorates Civgraph shows for Stormont contests are figures both print identically.

sources.title: Report and Analysis of the P.R. Urban Elections in Ulster held on 15 January 1920
sources.publisher: Proportional Representation Society of Ireland (Ulster Committee)
sources.reprint: Reprinted as PR Urban Elections in Ulster, 1920 (Electoral Reform Society, London, 1972).
sources.description: The Ulster Committee of the Proportional Representation Society of Ireland's report on the urban council elections held in Ulster on 15 January 1920 by the single transferable vote, under the Local Government (Ireland) Act 1919: results sheets for each ward, giving every stage of the count, and ward summaries. Reprinted as PR Urban Elections in Ulster, 1920 by the Electoral Reform Society, London, in 1972.
sources.uses: Cited for the Belfast County Borough Council ward results of 15 January 1920, each stage of each count transcribed from the reprint's results sheets.
sources.copyright: Cited for facts only; the report's text and tables are not reproduced.
